title.zh: 【Safe Labs 交易安全网络 Safenet 结束 Beta 阶段，推出生产版本】
title.en: 【Safe Labs 交易安全网络 Safenet 结束 Beta 阶段，推出生产版本】

current_state.zh: Safe Labs launched the production version of Safenet in Safe{Shield}, where BlockSec, Candide, IntentGuard and OpenCover stake collateral to review Safe multisig transactions before execution and record verdicts on-chain, starting with Safe Pro users on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Gnosis Chain.
current_state.en: Safe Labs launched the production version of Safenet in Safe{Shield}, where BlockSec, Candide, IntentGuard and OpenCover stake collateral to review Safe multisig transactions before execution and record verdicts on-chain, starting with Safe Pro users on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Gnosis Chain.
